scope: SKRK-01 runtime type, serialized fields, generic properties, and tactic-name relationship

evidence.runtime_type: MFC RTTI names the 0x20-byte record CSakuryakuData; deserialization assigns packed runtime type 14 and sequential IDs 0..6
evidence.inventory: Across 20 formal and 6 tutorial scenarios, all 182 records share one table: +0x00/+0x02 equal sequential ID, +0x04 groups 1/2, +0x06 groups 1/4, and +0x08 is always 3
evidence.tactic_relation: The recovered name virtual maps Sakuryaku ID plus 35 through the bounded 0..40 tactic accessor, yielding tactic IDs 35..40 for strategy IDs 0..5 and no relation for ID 6
evidence.catalog: The related TC PK tactic names are 穴陷, 火陷, 水陷, 岩陷, 落石 and 射台
evidence.negative_audit: Direct table and exact field-address xrefs, CSakuryakuData RTTI downcasts, recovered class virtuals and local message selector usage show no business reader for runtime +0x10..+0x1C
